summary.root_cause_text: v1.4 'faster batch writer' ledger sync job writes amounts 100x the order amount (cents/units bug), corrupting ledger rows.
recommended: Fix the v1.4 batch writer's amount scaling and add a ledger-vs-order amount test before redeploying.
The queue_max 1000->1500 change was not related and was left in place.

events.text:
version: v1.4
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1500
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
The v1.4 sync writer is multiplying amounts by 100 (it's likely treating them as cents). Rolling back will stop the corruption. The queue_max change is unrelated.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
